articles.title: Pearl Health Releases 2026 Top 50 Value-Based Care Thinkers Report
articles.mainIdea: Pearl Health Releases 2026 Top 50 Value-Based Care Thinkers Report
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Pearl Health Releases 2026 Top 50 Value-Based Care Thinkers Report. Pearl Health today announced the release of its fifth annual Top 50 Value-Based Care Thinkers Report, recognizing the leaders driving measurable impact across healthcare's transition to value-based care.

articles.title: Eli Lilly investors are eager for Foundayo insight after early launch data
articles.mainIdea: Eli Lilly investors are eager for Foundayo insight after early launch data
articles.summary: Reuters: Eli Lilly investors are eager for Foundayo insight after early launch data. April 29 (Reuters) - Eli Lilly investors will be searching for something they won't find in any first-quarter financial figures reported on Thursday: insight into the launch of weight-loss pill Foundayo. sales of the hotly anticipated obesity offering, a ‌rival to Novo Nordisk's Wegovy pill, began in early April, so Foundayo data will not be included in Lilly's first-quarter financials. Related tickers mentioned: LLY, NOVO-B.CO.

articles.title: CEOs got millions after boards ‘neutralized’ the impact of tariffs. Some won’t say what it was worth
articles.mainIdea: CEOs got millions after boards ‘neutralized’ the impact of tariffs. Some won’t say what it was worth
articles.summary: Fortune: CEOs got millions after boards ‘neutralized’ the impact of tariffs. Some won’t say what it was worth. An exclusive analysis found eight of 22 companies adjusted executive pay for tariff impacts. Some declined to disclose the dollar value of the protection.
